title: What PayFlow is
text: PayFlow is a fintech app for sending payments, managing cards, and tracking transaction history across mobile and web. This demo corpus is fictional and exists to give the specialist agents something to retrieve.

title: Who this demo is for
text: The PayFlow GenAI demo is an educational multi-agent system used in the Break Into AI Testing course. It routes questions to a Jira, Confluence, or Figma specialist, or answers from basic knowledge, and exposes its routing decision so the pipeline itself can be tested.

title: Support hours
text: PayFlow support is staffed 07:00–19:00 US Eastern, Monday through Friday. Outside those hours the in-app assistant handles account access and transaction lookup only.
